title: fix(audit-pr-cleanup): retry --apply internally until a re-scan reports zero new candidates
body:
## Background

`scripts/audit-pr-cleanup.mjs --apply` builds its candidate report
exactly once (`src/scripts/audit-pr-cleanup.mts:274`,
`const report = await buildReport(owner, repo, prNumber);`) and then
loops over that fixed list a single time to minimize each candidate
(lines 276-341), writing the final summary once afterward (lines
350-351). `revalidateCandidate()` (lines 1150-1191) already re-fetches
a fresh per-candidate check immediately before minimizing, which
correctly catches a sibling comment cascade-minimized earlier in the
*same* pass (the fix already shipped for issue #1039) — but nothing
re-scans for a candidate that only becomes eligible *after* the whole
pass already finished.

Reproduced independently across 6 of 6 F4 cleanup passes in one
adopter session (`kurone-kito/setup.ubuntu`, 2026-08-12/13, PRs #97,
#98, #100, #101, #102, #103): the first `--apply` call reports a
subset of the same-scoped dry-run's candidates as `applied`, with
`status` still `needs-apply`/`applied` rather than `clean`; an
immediate second, byte-identical `--apply` call then converges to
`candidates: 0, status: clean` with no further changes. Whether the
underlying cause is GitHub's GraphQL read-after-write propagation lag
on `minimizeComment`, or some other mid-run cascade the fixed
candidate list can't see, is not confirmed from source — but the
absence of any whole-run retry is confirmed, and is what forces the
second invocation regardless of the exact cause.

`.github/instructions/idd-merge.instructions.md:353-356`'s F4 cleanup
step currently routes any `--apply` outcome other than `applied`/`clean`
straight to a cleanup-failure comment, with no distinct "re-apply once,
then decide" branch — exactly the gap issue #1039's own (unmet)
acceptance criteria anticipated ("If any genuine re-apply-to-converge
state remains, `idd-merge.instructions.md` F4 documents it as distinct
from a cleanup failure").

No existing issue covers this: #1039 (closed) fixed a narrower
accounting bug (the applied count itself was undercounted on a
same-run cascade) and is not this residual, whole-run-retry gap.

## Proposed change

Have `audit-pr-cleanup.mjs --apply` retry the whole pass internally,
bounded (for example 3 attempts with a short backoff), re-running
`buildReport()` and re-minimizing any newly-reported candidate after
each pass, stopping as soon as a fresh report shows zero remaining
candidates or the attempt bound is reached. Report the final outcome
(`clean`, `applied`, or — only if the bound is exhausted with
candidates still remaining — `incomplete`) exactly as today, so
callers and F4's existing status handling in
`idd-merge.instructions.md` need no change for the common case; only
the "still incomplete after the bound" case is new, and should be
documented in F4 as distinct from a hard cleanup failure (matching
#1039's originally intended, unmet criterion), rather than routed
straight to the cleanup-failure comment path.

## Acceptance criteria

- `audit-pr-cleanup.mjs --apply` internally retries the full
  scan-and-minimize pass, bounded (e.g. 3 attempts, short backoff),
  until a fresh report shows zero remaining candidates or the bound is
  reached.
- A same-scoped dry-run immediately following a converged `--apply`
  reports `clean` without requiring a second manual `--apply`
  invocation, reproduced with a test simulating a candidate that only
  becomes eligible after the first internal pass.
- `--apply`'s final JSON output keeps its existing `clean`/`applied`
  fields unchanged for the common (single-pass-converges) case; the
  bound-exhausted case is distinguishable in the output from an
  ordinary `applied`/`clean` result.
- `.github/instructions/idd-merge.instructions.md`'s F4 cleanup step
  documents the bound-exhausted case as distinct from a cleanup
  failure, separate from the existing `failed`/`incomplete` routing to
  the cleanup-failure comment format.
- `pnpm run build` regenerates `scripts/audit-pr-cleanup.mjs` from the
  edited `.mts` source.
- `pnpm run lint:minimum` passes.

## Candidate files

- `src/scripts/audit-pr-cleanup.mts`
- `scripts/audit-pr-cleanup.mjs` (generated; regenerate via
  `pnpm run build`, do not hand-edit)
- `tests/audit-pr-cleanup.test.mts`
- `.github/instructions/idd-merge.instructions.md`
